svg.title: Agiliza Transparência — on-premise rack
svg.desc: The whole system runs on state-owned hardware, open source, at zero licence cost, so it is drawn as a rack rather than a list. Mounted from the edge inward: Traefik v3.6 as gateway, Keycloak 23 for SSO and IAM, Laravel 12 on PHP 8.2, PostgreSQL 17, a Next.js 16 client on React 19 and Tailwind 4, and Docker with Portainer and Playwright.
